# AVPS v2 post-consumption recovery4 successor infrastructure — zero-runtime review

Status: `REVIEW_ONLY_SUCCESSOR_INFRASTRUCTURE_NO_ORDINAL_SELECTED_NO_SCIENCE`.

This package is the mechanical recovery from the consumed recovery3 ordinal-44 pre-solver failure. It does not select, reserve, allocate, or imply the next scientific ordinal. It does not create a candidate seed ledger, authorization, dispatch ref, consumed marker, result-opening gate, Level-B admission, holdout access, or production transition. The only ordinal used by the executable fixture is an explicit synthetic sentinel that can never be promoted as a scientific identity.

The frozen AVPS science remains unchanged: 360 cases, 72 common-random-number groups, five aerosol profile states per group, 20,000,000 photon histories per case, the existing 380–780 nm/runtime/profile/source bindings, the existing estimator/threshold/result-opening contract, and no Taylor/Jerusalem residual use. The defect being repaired is routing, not science. Recovery3 correctly materialized a runtime adapter/executor/aggregator that rebound the reviewed recovery identity, but its science workflow built matrices by importing the old base adapter directly, executed cases through the old base executor PYTHONPATH, and aggregated through the old base aggregator PYTHONPATH. The wrappers remain byte-bound to the already-reviewed base implementation and refuse the consumed recovery3 stage/status/ordinal/seed identity.

The generated workflow is review material only until separately published by a later identity-specific gate.

The zero-runtime review fixture uses no `uvspec`, libRadtran, MYSTIC, OPAC download, photon histories, result opening, or real protected value. It exercises only authorization validation, 4x90 matrix assembly, wrapper guard validation, a synthetic closed 360-artifact structural aggregate, and deliberate refusal of old recovery3 stage/status, ordinal 44, and the consumed recovery3 seed hash.
